title: Ruth and Naomi
subtitle: Loyalty and compassion in a woman's heart

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Naomi was a widow Israelite woman, and her daughter-in-law Ruth was a foreigner. Both had lost everything and were desperate.

steps.speaker: Naomi
steps.text: Ruth, dear, you should return to your land. I have nothing to offer you here. Your life can be better with your own people.

steps.speaker: Ruth
steps.text: Naomi, I will go with you! Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God. I will not leave you alone.
Why did Ruth want to stay with Naomi?
options: Because she loved Naomi and was loyal
Because she wanted to earn money
Because she was afraid to return
steps.answer: Because she loved Naomi and was loyal

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Ruth and Naomi arrived in Bethlehem at harvest time. Ruth went to the fields and asked permission to glean the grain left behind by the harvesters.

steps.speaker: Ruth
steps.text: Please, may I glean in your field? I promise to work hard to get food for my mother-in-law.

steps.speaker: Boaz
steps.text: Of course you can, dear girl. I have heard about your loyalty to Naomi. That is worthy of praise.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Boaz was a rich and respected man. He saw Ruth's loyalty and began to love her. He protected her in the fields.
How did Boaz treat Ruth in the fields?
options: With kindness, offering water and protection
With coldness and contempt
He ignored her completely
steps.answer: With kindness, offering water and protection

steps.speaker: Boaz
steps.text: Ruth, I want to ask you to marry me. You are a woman worthy of honor and loyalty. I would like to care for you and Naomi.

steps.speaker: Ruth
steps.text: Yes! You are so kind to me. I accept being your wife.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Ruth and Boaz married. They had a son named Obed, who became the grandfather of King David.

steps.speaker: Naomi
steps.text: Praise be to God! My daughter-in-law redeemed me and gave me joy. Now we have hope and a future!
What was the result of Ruth's loyalty?
options: She found love, security, and a place in God's history
She remained poor forever
Naomi became unhappy again
steps.answer: She found love, security, and a place in God's history

title: The Birth of Jesus
subtitle: God enters the world as a baby

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Mary was a young woman from Nazareth. One day, the angel Gabriel appeared to her with surprising news.

steps.speaker: Gabriel
steps.text: Do not be afraid, Mary! You have been chosen among all women. You will conceive and bear a son called Jesus.

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.text: How can this be? I have no husband. How can I have a son?

steps.speaker: Gabriel
steps.text: The Holy Spirit will come upon you. The son will be called the Son of God. His kingdom will have no end.
How did Mary respond to the angel's news?
options: With faith, saying she would do God's will
With anger and disbelief
Fleeing from the angel in fear
steps.answer: With faith, saying she would do God's will

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Mary was betrothed to Joseph, a righteous carpenter. When he learned of Mary, he planned to leave her secretly. But an angel appeared to him in a dream.

steps.speaker: Angel
steps.text: Joseph, do not be afraid. The son of Mary is of the Holy Spirit. Call him Jesus, for he will save his people from sin.

steps.speaker: Joseph
steps.text: I understand now. I will accept this mission. I will be the earthly father of Jesus and care for Mary.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Mary and Joseph traveled to Bethlehem because the emperor ordered a census. Everyone needed to register in their hometown.
Why did Mary and Joseph go to Bethlehem?
options: Because of the census ordered by the emperor
Because they wanted a trip
Because their relative lived there
steps.answer: Because of the census ordered by the emperor

steps.speaker: Mary
steps.text: I need to find a place to give birth. My son is arriving!

steps.speaker: Innkeeper
steps.text: I'm sorry, but there are no rooms. The inn is full. You can stay in the stable if you like.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Jesus was born in a simple stable. Mary wrapped him in swaddling clothes and laid him in a manger full of straw.

steps.speaker: Shepherds
steps.text: What is this brightness? What is happening in the sky?

steps.speaker: Angel
steps.text: Do not fear! I have good news of great joy for all people. Today in the city of David, the Savior has been born!
Who were the first to know about the birth of Jesus?
options: The shepherds in the fields, when the angel appeared to them
The wise men
The Roman emperor
steps.answer: The shepherds in the fields, when the angel appeared to them

steps.speaker: Shepherds
steps.text: Let's go to Bethlehem and see the baby! The angel said he is wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger!

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The shepherds ran and found Jesus, Mary, and Joseph. They worshipped the baby and told everyone what they heard.

steps.speaker: Wise Men from the East
steps.text: A new star has appeared! It means a great king has been born. Let's go and worship him with gifts.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: The wise men traveled from far away following a star. They found Jesus and offered him gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

title: Jesus Calms the Storm
subtitle: Jesus has power even over the elements of nature

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Jesus and his disciples were in a boat on the Sea of Galilee. Jesus was so tired he fell asleep.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Suddenly, a terrible storm began. The wind blew fiercely and huge waves beat against the boat.

steps.speaker: Disciple 1
steps.text: Sirs! We are sinking! The boat is filling with water! We are going to die!

steps.speaker: Disciple 2
steps.text: Where is Jesus? Why doesn't he help us? Doesn't he care?
Why were the disciples afraid?
options: Because a violent storm surrounded them
Because they couldn't swim
Because they heard about pirates
steps.answer: Because a violent storm surrounded them

steps.speaker: Disciple 1
steps.text: Jesus! Wake up! Please, wake up! We are dying!
Jesus woke up and saw fear on his disciples' faces. He got up with calm and authority.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Jesus
steps.text: Why are you afraid? Where is your faith?

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Peace! Be still!
Jesus spoke to the wind and the waves. And immediately, a great peace came down. The wind ceased and the waters calmed.
steps.speaker: Narrator

steps.text: How did the storm end?
options: Jesus ordered the wind and waves to calm down
The disciples rowed away from the storm
Another ship helped them
steps.answer: Jesus ordered the wind and waves to calm down

steps.speaker: Disciple 2
steps.text: Jesus! What kind of man are you? Even the wind and sea obey you!

steps.speaker: Disciple 3
steps.text: He must be the Messiah! No one else has this power!

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: You saw my power. Know that I have authority even over nature. Trust me, for I am always with you.

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: All the disciples were filled with amazement. They understood that Jesus was not just a teacher, but the Son of God.

title: Zacchaeus
subtitle: A small man finds salvation in Jesus

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Zacchaeus was a tax collector in Jericho. He was very small in stature and very rich, but hated by everyone.
Zacchaeus is a traitor! He collects more taxes than he should and keeps the money. He is a snake!
steps.speaker: People of Jericho
Narrator
steps.text: One day, Jesus passed through Jericho. Crowds followed him. Zacchaeus wanted to see Jesus, but he was too short.

steps.speaker: Zacchaeus
steps.text: I can't see! This crowd is too big. No one will let a tax collector pass in front.
Why did Zacchaeus have difficulty seeing Jesus?
options: Because he was very short and the crowd was large
Because his eyes were closed
Because he was very far away
steps.answer: Because he was very short and the crowd was large

steps.speaker: Narrator
steps.text: Zacchaeus saw an opportunity. He ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus pass.

steps.speaker: Zacchaeus
steps.text: Perfect! From up in this tree I can see Jesus without any problem!
When Jesus passed near the tree, he looked up and saw Zacchaeus.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Jesus
steps.text: Zacchaeus! Come down! I want to go to your house today!

steps.speaker: Zacchaeus
steps.text: You want to come to my house? I am so hated! But I'll come down quick!
How did Zacchaeus feel when Jesus noticed him?
options: Surprised and happy because Jesus chose him
Furious because Jesus saw him
Indifferent
steps.answer: Surprised and happy because Jesus chose him

steps.speaker: People of Jericho
steps.text: How terrible! Jesus is going to the house of Zacchaeus? A corrupt tax collector?
As they ate, Zacchaeus was transformed by his encounter with Jesus. He saw his sin and wanted to change.
steps.speaker: Narrator
Zacchaeus
steps.text: Jesus, I want to change! I will give half of my possessions to the poor and give back four times what I stole!

steps.speaker: Jesus
steps.text: Today salvation has entered your house. You are truly a son of Abraham. For the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.
How was Zacchaeus transformed?
options: He repented and changed his life, wanting to make amends
He continued stealing as before
He tried to buy Jesus' favor
steps.answer: He repented and changed his life, wanting to make amends
